svg.aria-label: A day in the life of a web request: the laptop joins the network with DHCP, uses ARP to find the gateway MAC address, asks DNS for the server IP, opens a TCP connection and TLS session routed across ISPs by BGP and OSPF, then sends the HTTP request and gets the page.
svg.title: A day in the life of a web request: the laptop joins the network with DHCP, uses ARP to find the gateway MAC address, asks DNS for the server IP, opens a TCP connection and TLS session routed across ISPs by BGP and OSPF, then sends the HTTP request and gets the page.
svg.text: Every layer from this book in one click: link (Ethernet/Wi-Fi), network (IP, OSPF, BGP),
transport (UDP for DNS, TCP for the page) and application (DHCP, DNS, TLS, HTTP).
